title: The Jacksoning Combat Tweaks
description: Combat tweaks designed for The Jacksoning
body: This mod removes damage invincibility frames. In their place, players receive *knockback* invincibility frames during which time they cannot take knockback. Items with the `jacksoning_combat_tweaks:bypass_knockback_cooldown` component will bypass these invincibility frames, allowing for insane combos. Other mobs do not receive these invincibility frames, so they can be comboed endlessly.
